hypothesis: After excluding every date used by the prior pilot/model and 13Z content probe, ten metadata-only shared US dates can provide exactly 110 balanced events within a bounded two-cycle NBM and market-history acquisition budget.

cohort.excluded_date_rationale: union of all 20 prior selected dates and the three 13Z probe dates, deduplicated
cohort.selection_rule: Among remaining dates with exactly one event for every city, sort ascending and choose unique indices round(i*(n-1)/9), i=0..9.

planned_inputs.conservative_nbm_transfer: 20 times the maximum object byte count observed in locked 07Z/13Z probes
planned_inputs.market_requests: sum selected bucket counts only after event IDs freeze

decision_rule.pass: Freeze IDs and request volumes, then separately preregister price and two-cycle NBM collection gates.
decision_rule.fail: Do not acquire new price or NBM data; redesign sample size or obtain prospective observations.
